INSANITY ROCKS!!

August 16, 2005

Wild!! Thats how i feel … though [Song in Ear ::: Till Kingdom comes - Coldplay ::: Feeling.. ummm.. maybe, little down and blue. But not really bad] day hasn’t started all that awesome!
[Song in Ear :: Where’s my mind - Pixies :: Feel Inordinately delirious]
Sure, people i say “Lets get naked!!” Isn’t that an awesome idea. I have always wondered how “awesome” it would be, to be free, unto the skin.
ssss Where’s is my mind ssss …
Have to make a official call to New York, and though with every moment i am “late”.. i just want to be more in trouble.

[Song in ear :: Speed of sound - coldplay :: Doped out..It’s elating!] la llaaa laa laaaa ….yeeee yyay! [Giggles].. am not on crack, neither am drunk…but just like earlier am "high on life".
I feel empty..deviod of any feelings.. i have been posting so much.. that i have become “emptier” than i ever was!
Also, i have relentlessly started speaking truth. Blunt often, bitter most of the time and scarcely pleasing..
i “love” that detesting expression for me, on people’s face.. So finally not only i am a “misanthrope” i have started wishing that people hate me. I want them too.. and with each passing day i am getting good at it. Life has paid off finally!!
Insanity Rocks!!
